approach: At constant pressure the fraction of heat converted into work equals R divided by Cp, the molar heat capacity at constant pressure.

steps.text: Write Cp for a diatomic gas.
Write the fraction of heat that becomes work.
Convert the fraction to a percentage.

common_mistakes.text: Computing the percentage of heat that raises the internal energy, Cv/Cp = 5/7 = 71.4%, instead of the percentage converted to work.
